title: Vhufunzi
author: Lumni
content:
# Vhufunzi

Ngei kusini kwa tshikolo, ho ne hu na mushumanyi wa vhukuma wa vhunzhi. Mushumanyi uyu o vha a tshi pfi Mukondeleli. O vha a tshi divha uri vhufunzi ndi zwa ndeme kha vhuthu.

Ngei tshikoloni tsha vhupo, ho vha hu na musidzana o no vhofholowa a tshi pfi Nyambeni. Nyambeni o vha a sa tendi uri vhufunzi vhu a thusa. O vha a tshi humbula uri u vhuya ndi nḓila khwine ya u ita.

Ngunwe ḓuvha, vhakololo vha vha netshedza mushumo wa u ṅwala zwiimo zwa phosiso kha ḓorobo. Nyambeni o vha a si na mushumo wa u ita. O vha a songo ita mushumo wawe. Nga u vhuya, o ri o ita mushumo wawe ngeno a sa ita.

Vhagudisi vha vha tshi khou toda uri vhakololo vha ambe zwa vhukuma. Vha ri: "Ndi nnyi ane a nga ri amba uri zwo itea hani?"

Mukondeleli o ima. O vha o vhona Nyambeni a tshi vhuya. O ri: "Mme Mufunzi, ndi nga humbela u amba tshithu?"

"Ee, Mukondeleli, amba."

"Ndi khou vhona uri vhune ha itea kha mushumo wa Nyambeni a si wa vhukuma. Ndi khou humbela uri ri thome u shuma vhukuma."

Nyambeni o vha o pfuka. O vha o tangana na tshilidzi. O ri: "Ndi a livhuwa, Mukondeleli. U mphudza u vhona uri vhufunzi vhu a thusa u fhira u vhuya."

U bva ngunwe iṋe, Nyambeni o shanduka. A thoma u amba vhukuma nga nyambo dzawe. A wana uri vhathu vha a mu fulufhela nga nṱha ha izwi. Mushumo wa vhukuma wo mu thusa u vha na vhuthu vhutanzi.

## Pfunzo dza ndeme

1. **Vhufunzi** — U amba vhukuma hu u ita zwavhuḓi. Vhathu vha a u fulufhela musi u tshi amba vhukuma.
2. **U shanduka** — Hu si kale u nga shanduka na u ita zwa vhukuma.
3. **Vhuthu** — Vhufunzi vhu a thusa u vha na vhuthu vhutanzi.

## Maipfi a ndeme

|-----------|---------|----------------|

| vhukuma | truth | noun |
| fulufhela | trust | verb |

vocabulary.definition: Honesty; the quality of being truthful
Truth; what is true and real
To trust or have confidence in someone
To change or transform from one state to another
Importance; the quality of being significant
